text: ナナシマの　いせきは　いくつか　あるが　かなり　むかしから　ある　ものが　おおい

structure.jp: ナナシマの　いせきは　いくつか　あるが
structure.en: there are several ruins in the Sevii Islands, and

structure.jp: かなり　むかしから　ある　ものが
structure.en: ones that have been there since quite long ago

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: かなり　むかしから　ある　もの
patterns.explanation: A short sentence put right before a thing-word describes it. かなり　むかしから　ある　もの = 'ones that have been there since quite long ago'.

patterns.name: 〜が (but)
patterns.explanation: が at the end of a statement links it to the next one, like a light 'but' or 'and'. いくつか　あるが = 'there are several, and'.
